title: Family Fork
setup: Black's king and rook are both still on their home squares, and your knight on b5 is close by.
hint: There is one knight square that attacks the king on e8 and the rook on a8 at the same time.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nc7+}} checks the king on e8 and attacks the rook on a8. The king must move, and {{Nxa8}} takes the rook.

A knight in the corner is often trapped there, but not this one: the pawn on a5 guards b6, so the knight has a safe way out. Before you grab a piece in the corner, check that your knight can get home.
